goal: Signed commits gate: commits to protected branches traced to a verified author.
use: Signed commits gate: commits to protected branches traced to a verified author. Use when a branch is protected or a release is cut.

steps.note: Confirm the protected branches are listed.
Set the rule. Unsigned commits cannot be merged into protected branches.
Check key management. Signing keys are personal and revocable.
Check exceptions. Service accounts need a documented process.
Report. The branches, the verification result and any unsigned commits.
